headline: HR Departments Face Year-End Planning Risks and Labor Compliance
summary: Human resources departments face heightened year-end planning requirements to avoid scheduling, hiring, and time-tracking errors and labor compliance risks.
why: Year-end workforce management and regulatory compliance affect operational productivity and labor cost control for enterprises.

impacts.name: Human Resources
impacts.why: Strict labor planning minimizes legal liabilities and administrative costs.
